title: RadarTwin-UAV: Synthetic Radar Scenario and Digital Twin Generator for small-UAV detection (S1)
description: RadarTwin-UAV (software component S1) is a self-contained C++17 digital twin that generates reproducible synthetic radar corpora for the detection, classification and multi-target tracking of small unmanned aerial vehicles. It models the motion of UAVs, birds and other aerial objects, a radar sensor (range, azimuth, elevation, radial velocity, SNR, clutter, observation completeness and micro-Doppler), clutter, missed detections and measurement errors. It supports individual, simultaneous, sequential and combined multi-target scenarios and emits fully-labelled ground truth together with the scenario configuration, random seed and run metadata (CSV/JSON). Reference software accompanying the manuscript on Uncertainty-Aware Spatiotemporal Radar Fusion (UST-Fuse). Part 1 of 3 (S1, S2, S3).
